exact: non-canonical Wnt receptor signaling pathway involved in heart development
non-canonical Wnt receptor signalling pathway involved in heart development
non-canonical Wnt-activated signaling pathway involved in heart development

definition: The series of molecular signals initiated by binding of a Wnt protein to a frizzled family receptor on the surface of the target cell, followed by propagation of the signal via effectors other than beta-catenin and contributing to the progression of the heart over time.
label: non-canonical Wnt signaling pathway involved in heart development
